items.title: Arrows browse again
items.text: With a picture-in-picture window showing, the arrow keys no longer jump to it. They move around the page, and when they reach an edge they simply stop.

items.title: Double-click OK to reach the window
items.text: Press OK twice quickly to put the focus on the film or camera window in the corner. Press OK once more to open it full screen.

items.title: Swap and leave
items.text: While the window has the focus, Left, Right and Down swap between the film and the camera. Back or Up hands the arrows back to the page.
